verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at docs.smooth.sh that indexes Markdown versions of the docs pages, and every docs page is served as `.md`. The docs also include agent-oriented CLI guides for Claude Code, OpenClaw and other agents. One community member noted the docs pages aren't very token-efficient, which tempers quality but doesn't contradict the llms.txt capability. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or consolidated agent context file, independent hands-on corroboration of pointing an agent at the docs, token-efficient doc formatting.
